prompt.hi: IPL final ke tickets 10 baje open honge. 50 lakh log, 1 lakh seats.
prompt.en: IPL final tickets open at 10 AM. 5 million people, 100,000 seats.

why.hi: Same seat pe contention aur sudden spike. BookMyShow wala design + waiting room.
why.en: Contention on the same seats plus a sudden spike. BookMyShow design plus a waiting room.

prompt.hi: Zomato pe "order live track karo" feature: delivery boy ki location har 5 sec me customer ko dikhe.
prompt.en: Zomato "track your order live": the delivery partner's location should reach the customer every 5 seconds.

why.hi: Write-heavy location updates aur real-time push to one subscriber.
why.en: Write-heavy location updates and a real-time push to a single subscriber.

prompt.hi: Instagram Reels pe view count dikhana hai. Billions of views per day.
prompt.en: Show the view count on Instagram Reels. Billions of views per day.

why.hi: Har view pe DB write nahi kar sakte. Batch/stream me aggregate karo.
why.en: You cannot do a DB write per view. Aggregate in batches or in a stream.

prompt.hi: PhonePe me "Send ₹500" button user ne do baar daba diya, network slow tha.
prompt.en: On PhonePe the user tapped "Send ₹500" twice because the network was slow.

why.hi: Retry se duplicate payment na ho. Server same key pe same result de.
why.en: A retry must not create a duplicate payment. The server returns the same result for the same key.

prompt.hi: Public API ke free users ko 100 requests/min se zyada nahi dena.
prompt.en: Free users of a public API must not get more than 100 requests per minute.

why.hi: Classic rate limiter. Distributed counter jo atomic ho.
why.en: Classic rate limiter. A distributed counter that is atomic.

prompt.hi: Virat Kohli post karta hai, 25 crore followers ke feed me dikhana hai.
prompt.en: Virat Kohli posts and it must show up in the feeds of 250 million followers.

why.hi: Celebrity ke liye fan-out on write bahut mehenga. Read time pe merge karo.
why.en: Fan-out on write is too expensive for a celebrity. Merge their posts at read time.

prompt.hi: Users 2GB ki video upload karte hain, phir 4 qualities me play honi chahiye.
prompt.en: Users upload 2 GB videos, which must then play in 4 qualities.

why.hi: Heavy blob aur long-running task. API server pe file mat lao.
why.en: Heavy blob and a long-running task. Keep the file off the API servers.

prompt.hi: Amazon search box me "iph" type karte hi suggestions 50ms me aayein.
prompt.en: Typing "iph" into the Amazon search box should show suggestions within 50 ms.

why.hi: Read latency critical hai. Query time pe compute mat karo.
why.en: Read latency is critical. Do not compute at query time.

prompt.hi: Order place hua: payment, inventory aur delivery teen alag services me update hona hai.
prompt.en: An order is placed: payment, inventory and delivery must update in three separate services.

why.hi: Distributed transaction bina 2PC ke.
why.en: A distributed transaction without 2PC.

prompt.hi: Har roz raat 2 baje 1 crore users ko unka monthly statement email karna hai.
prompt.en: Every night at 2 AM, email 10 million users their monthly statement.

why.hi: Bulk async kaam jo fail-safe ho.
why.en: Bulk async work that must be fail-safe.

prompt.hi: Dream11 contest me live rank dikhana hai, 50 lakh players.
prompt.en: Show live ranks in a Dream11 contest with 5 million players.

why.hi: Top-K aur "meri rank" fast chahiye.
why.en: Both top-K and "my rank" have to be fast.

prompt.hi: Product page pe price 1 crore log dekh rahe hain, update kabhi-kabhi hota hai.
prompt.en: 10 million people are viewing a product page price, and it changes only occasionally.

why.hi: Read-heavy, thoda stale chalega.
why.en: Read-heavy, and slightly stale data is acceptable.

prompt.hi: India-Pak match ka toss hote hi Hotstar pe 5 minute me 3 crore concurrent viewers aa jaate hain.
prompt.en: At the India-Pakistan toss, Hotstar jumps to 30 million concurrent viewers within 5 minutes.

hi: CDN edge caching of video segments
en: CDN edge caching of video segments

why.hi: Spike predictable hai, autoscaling itna fast nahi. Pehle se scale karo aur load CDN pe daalo.
why.en: The spike is predictable but autoscaling is too slow. Scale ahead of time and push load to the CDN.

prompt.hi: Zerodha ka orders table 500 crore rows ka ho gaya, ek Postgres ab write aur query dono me slow hai.
prompt.en: Zerodha's orders table has grown to 5 billion rows and a single Postgres is now slow for both writes and queries.

why.hi: Ek machine ki limit cross ho gayi. User ke saare orders ek shard pe rakho taaki common query single shard pe chale.
why.en: One machine's limit is crossed. Keep all of a user's orders on one shard so common queries hit a single shard.

prompt.hi: Swiggy ke cache cluster me 10 se 12 nodes kiye, aur hash(key) % N ki wajah se almost saari keys miss hone lagi, DB pe load phat gaya.
prompt.en: Swiggy grew its cache cluster from 10 to 12 nodes, and because of hash(key) % N almost every key started missing and the DB got overloaded.

why.hi: Mod N me node add karne pe sab keys remap hoti hain. Consistent hashing me sirf ~1/N keys move hoti hain.
why.en: With mod N, adding a node remaps every key. With consistent hashing only about 1/N of keys move.

prompt.hi: Do data centers ke beech network toot gaya. Paytm wallet balance aur reel ke likes, dono ke liye kya karoge?
prompt.en: The network between two data centers breaks. What do you do for the Paytm wallet balance and for reel likes?

hi: CP for wallet (reject writes, stay correct)
en: CP for wallet (reject writes, stay correct)

why.hi: Partition me consistency ya availability me se ek chunna padta hai. Paisa galat nahi ho sakta, likes thode late chalenge.
why.en: During a partition you pick consistency or availability. Money cannot be wrong, likes can be a little late.

prompt.hi: WhatsApp pe message bheja, receiver ka phone off hai. On hote hi message mile aur sender ko double tick dikhe.
prompt.en: A WhatsApp message is sent while the receiver's phone is off. It must arrive when the phone comes back, and the sender must see double ticks.

why.hi: Pehle store karo, phir deliver. Har tick ek ack event hai jo sender tak wapas push hota hai.
why.en: Store first, then deliver. Each tick is an ack event pushed back to the sender.

prompt.hi: Ola app khulte hi 2 km ke andar ki cabs map pe dikhni chahiye. Drivers har 4 sec me location bhejte hain.
prompt.en: When the Ola app opens, it should show cabs within 2 km on the map. Drivers send their location every 4 seconds.

why.hi: Lat/long pe normal index kaam nahi karta. Grid cells me bucket karo, purani location ka koi kaam nahi.
why.en: A normal index on lat/long does not work. Bucket into grid cells, and old locations have no value.

prompt.hi: Meesho pe user "red kurtee under 500" search karta hai, typo ke saath bhi sahi results aane chahiye.
prompt.en: A Meesho user searches "red kurtee under 500" and should still get the right results despite the typo.

why.hi: SQL LIKE se full-text search nahi hota. Alag search index rakho jo DB changes se async update ho.
why.en: SQL LIKE cannot do full-text search. Keep a separate search index updated asynchronously from DB changes.

prompt.hi: Flipkart Big Billion Days pe 3 data centers me orders ban rahe hain. Order ID unique aur time-sortable chahiye, central DB ke bina.
prompt.en: During Flipkart Big Billion Days orders are created in 3 data centers. Order IDs must be unique and time-sortable without a central DB.

why.hi: Har node khud ID bana sake, coordination ke bina. Timestamp aage hone se IDs roughly sorted rehti hain.
why.en: Each node generates IDs on its own without coordination. Putting the timestamp first keeps IDs roughly sorted.

prompt.hi: HDFC ke SMS me lamba URL fit nahi hota. Short link chahiye jo crore baar click ho.
prompt.en: A long URL does not fit in an HDFC SMS. They need a short link that gets clicked millions of times.

why.hi: Write kam, read bahut zyada. ID se short code banao aur redirect cache se serve karo.
why.en: Few writes, very many reads. Derive the short code from an ID and serve redirects from cache.

prompt.hi: Swiggy order history me scroll karte karte page 500 pe API 3 sec le rahi hai, aur naye orders aane se items repeat ho rahe hain.
prompt.en: Scrolling Swiggy order history, the API takes 3 seconds by page 500, and new orders cause items to repeat.

why.hi: OFFSET saari skipped rows padhta hai aur shifting data pe toot jaata hai. Last seen cursor se aage padho.
why.en: OFFSET reads every skipped row and breaks when data shifts. Continue from the last-seen cursor.

prompt.hi: Ek partner bank ka UPI API 30 sec me respond kar raha hai. Threads atak gaye aur poora checkout down ho gaya.
prompt.en: One partner bank's UPI API takes 30 seconds to respond. Threads pile up and the whole checkout goes down.

why.hi: Ek slow dependency poore system ko gira deti hai. Fail fast karo aur failure ko isolate karo.
why.en: One slow dependency can take down the whole system. Fail fast and isolate the failure.

prompt.hi: Hotstar home screen pe "For You" row har user ke liye alag, 30 crore users, 100ms me load ho.
prompt.en: The Hotstar home screen "For You" row is personalized for each of 300 million users and must load in 100 ms.

why.hi: Lakhs items ko har request pe rank nahi kar sakte. Pehle cheap filter se candidates, phir model se ranking.
why.en: You cannot rank millions of items per request. Use a cheap filter for candidates, then rank them with a model.

prompt.hi: PhonePe ki 2000 microservices ke logs. On-call engineer ko trace ID se pichhle 15 min ke errors 2 sec me chahiye.
prompt.en: Logs from PhonePe's 2,000 microservices. The on-call engineer needs errors from the last 15 minutes by trace ID within 2 seconds.

hi: Indexed hot storage + cheap cold storage
en: Indexed hot storage + cheap cold storage

why.hi: Write volume huge hai aur bursty. Kafka absorb kare, recent data fast index me, purana sasta store.
why.en: Write volume is huge and bursty. Kafka absorbs it, recent data sits in a fast index, old data in cheap storage.

prompt.hi: Big Billion Days pe sirf 100 iPhones ₹49,999 me, 10 lakh log ek saath "Buy" dabaate hain. Oversell bilkul nahi.
prompt.en: Only 100 iPhones at ₹49,999 on Big Billion Days, and 1 million people hit "Buy" at once. No overselling allowed.

why.hi: Ek hi counter pe hot contention. Stock check aur decrement ek atomic step me ho, payment na ho to release karo.
why.en: Hot contention on a single counter. Check and decrement stock in one atomic step, and release it if payment fails.

prompt.hi: CSK fan server ke ek channel me 10 lakh members. Match ke time har second hazaar messages, sab ko real-time dikhne chahiye.
prompt.en: One channel on a CSK fan server has 1 million members. During matches thousands of messages arrive per second and everyone should see them in real time.

why.hi: Per-user inbox me copy karna impossible. Message ek baar channel me likho, gateways online subscribers ko push karein.
why.en: Copying into each user's inbox is impossible. Write once to the channel and let gateways push to online subscribers.

prompt.hi: Ek Bengaluru startup ka AI chatbot: GPUs limited hain, jawab word-by-word aana chahiye, aur peak pe 10x traffic aata hai.
prompt.en: A Bengaluru startup's AI chatbot: GPUs are limited, replies must stream word by word, and peak traffic is 10x.

why.hi: GPU sabse mehenga resource hai. Batching se utilization badhao, queue aur limits se overload bachao, streaming se latency kam lage.
why.en: The GPU is the most expensive resource. Batch to raise utilization, use queues and limits to avoid overload, and stream so latency feels low.

prompt.hi: Company ka shared doc: 10 log ek hi paragraph ek saath edit kar rahe hain, kisi ka change gayab nahi hona chahiye.
prompt.en: A shared company doc: 10 people edit the same paragraph at once, and nobody's change may be lost.

why.hi: Last-write-wins se edits overwrite hote hain. Operations ko merge karo taaki sab ek hi state pe converge karein.
why.en: Last-write-wins overwrites edits. Merge operations so every client converges to the same state.

prompt.hi: Ad network ko har campaign ke clicks per minute count karke advertiser ko bill karna hai. Double count ya miss dono nahi chalega.
prompt.en: An ad network must count clicks per minute for each campaign and bill advertisers. Neither double counting nor missed clicks is acceptable.

why.hi: Paisa juda hai to accuracy chahiye. Stream fast numbers deta hai, raat ka batch job unhe verify karta hai.
why.en: Money is involved, so accuracy matters. The stream gives fast numbers and a nightly batch job verifies them.

prompt.hi: Laptop pe 1GB ki Excel file me ek cell badla. Sync me poori file dobara upload nahi honi chahiye.
prompt.en: One cell changed in a 1 GB Excel file on a laptop. Sync must not re-upload the whole file.

hi: Metadata DB separate from blob store
en: Metadata DB separate from blob store

why.hi: File ko chunks me todo, sirf badle hue chunk bhejo. Metadata aur actual bytes alag store hote hain.
why.en: Split the file into chunks and send only the changed ones. Metadata and raw bytes live in separate stores.

prompt.hi: Ola ko apna DynamoDB jaisa KV store banana hai. Koi bhi node kabhi bhi mar sakta hai, phir bhi data available rahe.
prompt.en: Ola wants to build its own DynamoDB-like KV store. Any node can die at any time and the data must stay available.

why.hi: Data ko nodes pe baanto aur replicate karo. Quorum se tunable consistency milti hai.
why.en: Partition data across nodes and replicate it. Quorums give you tunable consistency.

prompt.hi: Swiggy: orders aur payments ek taraf, doosri taraf har user tap ka clickstream (roz 500 crore events). Dono ke liye kaunsa DB?
prompt.en: Swiggy: orders and payments on one side, and every user-tap clickstream on the other (5 billion events per day). Which DB for each?

why.hi: Orders ko ACID chahiye, events ko massive write throughput. Ek DB sab ke liye best nahi hota.
why.en: Orders need ACID, events need massive write throughput. No single DB is best for everything.

prompt.hi: World Cup ke time India me pichhle 1 ghante ke top 10 trending hashtags har minute update karne hain.
prompt.en: During the World Cup, update India's top 10 trending hashtags of the last hour every minute.

why.hi: Har hashtag ka exact count memory me nahi rakh sakte. Approximate count + heap se top-K nikalo.
why.en: You cannot keep exact counts for every hashtag in memory. Use approximate counts plus a heap for top-K.

prompt.hi: Swiggy order status pe push, SMS aur email jaane chahiye, user preferences ke hisaab se. SMS provider down ho to bhi message jaaye.
prompt.en: Swiggy order status updates must go out as push, SMS and email based on user preferences, even if the SMS provider is down.

why.hi: Har channel alag speed aur failure mode. Queue se decouple karo, ek provider fail ho to doosra use karo.
why.en: Each channel has its own speed and failure mode. Decouple with queues and switch providers on failure.

prompt.hi: Zerodha ka end-of-day settlement job 3 servers pe deploy hai. Roz sirf ek hi baar chalna chahiye, teen baar nahi.
prompt.en: Zerodha's end-of-day settlement job is deployed on 3 servers. It must run exactly once a day, not three times.

why.hi: Leader/lock se ek hi worker chalega. Lease expire ho jaaye to fencing token purane worker ke writes rok deta hai.
why.en: A leader or lock ensures one worker runs. If the lease expires, a fencing token blocks the stale worker's writes.

prompt.hi: PhonePe checkout me har mahine naya payment method aata hai (UPI Lite, BNPL, card EMI). Har baar if-else chain lambi ho jaati hai.
prompt.en: PhonePe checkout gets a new payment method every month (UPI Lite, BNPL, card EMI). The if-else chain grows each time.

why.hi: Har method ek alag class jo common interface implement kare. Naya method = nayi class, purana code touch nahi.
why.en: Each method is a separate class implementing a common interface. A new method means a new class, with no edits to old code.

prompt.hi: Metro station ki vending machine: coin daala, item chuna, dispense hua. Har step pe behaviour alag, galat button pe kuch nahi hona chahiye.
prompt.en: A metro station vending machine: insert coin, pick item, dispense. Behaviour differs at each step, and a wrong button should do nothing.

why.hi: Har state apna behaviour khud handle kare, bade switch-case ki jagah.
why.en: Each state handles its own behaviour instead of one giant switch-case.

prompt.hi: Canva jaisa design editor: har action (move, resize, color) ka Undo/Redo chahiye.
prompt.en: A Canva-like design editor: every action (move, resize, color) needs Undo/Redo.

why.hi: Har action ek object bane jo khud ko reverse kar sake, ya state ka snapshot save ho.
why.en: Each action becomes an object that can reverse itself, or a snapshot of state is saved.

prompt.hi: Meesho Razorpay se Cashfree pe shift kar raha hai. Cashfree SDK ke method names aur params bilkul alag hain, par app code nahi badalna.
prompt.en: Meesho is moving from Razorpay to Cashfree. Cashfree's SDK has completely different method names and params, but app code must not change.

why.hi: App apne PaymentGateway interface se baat kare. Adapter third-party SDK ko us interface me convert kare.
why.en: The app talks to its own PaymentGateway interface. An adapter translates the third-party SDK to that interface.

prompt.hi: Cricbuzz me score badalte hi scorecard screen, home widget aur push notification teeno update hon. Kal smartwatch bhi add hoga.
prompt.en: When the Cricbuzz score changes, the scorecard screen, home widget and push notification all update. A smartwatch will be added tomorrow.

why.hi: Score source ko pata nahi hona chahiye kaun sun raha hai. Naya listener bas subscribe kare.
why.en: The score source should not know who is listening. A new listener just subscribes.

prompt.hi: Domino's order object: size, crust, 10 optional toppings, extra cheese, coupon. Constructor me 14 parameters ho gaye.
prompt.en: A Domino's order object: size, crust, 10 optional toppings, extra cheese, coupon. The constructor now has 14 parameters.

why.hi: Bahut saare optional fields wala object step-by-step readable tarike se banao.
why.en: Build an object with many optional fields step by step in a readable way.

prompt.hi: Logger banana hai: DEBUG console pe, ERROR file me bhi, FATAL pe on-call ko alert bhi. Poori app me ek hi logger instance.
prompt.en: Build a logger: DEBUG goes to console, ERROR also to a file, FATAL also alerts on-call. One logger instance for the whole app.

why.hi: Har handler apna level dekhe aur aage pass kare. Naya handler chain me jodo, baaki code same.
why.en: Each handler checks its level and passes the message on. Add a handler to the chain without touching the rest.

prompt.hi: Zomato ki OrderService class validate karti hai, DB me save karti hai, invoice PDF banati hai aur email bhi bhejti hai. 2000 lines.
prompt.en: Zomato's OrderService class validates, saves to the DB, generates the invoice PDF and sends email. 2,000 lines.

hi: Split into Validator, Repository, InvoiceGenerator, Notifier
en: Split into Validator, Repository, InvoiceGenerator, Notifier

why.hi: Ek class ke badalne ke 4 alag reasons hain. Har responsibility ki alag class banao.
why.en: The class has 4 separate reasons to change. Give each responsibility its own class.

prompt.hi: Rapido me Vehicle base class me refuel() hai. ElectricScooter aur Bicycle usse extend karke refuel() me exception throw karte hain.
prompt.en: In Rapido, the Vehicle base class has refuel(). ElectricScooter and Bicycle extend it and throw an exception from refuel().

why.hi: Subclass parent ki jagah use ho to crash nahi hona chahiye. Chhote interfaces banao, sirf jo lagu ho wahi implement karo.
why.en: A subclass used in place of its parent must not crash. Create small interfaces and implement only what applies.

prompt.hi: Config me likha hai "SMS", "EMAIL" ya "WHATSAPP". Code ko us type ka sender object banana hai, bina har jagah new likhe.
prompt.en: The config says "SMS", "EMAIL" or "WHATSAPP". Code must create the matching sender object without writing new everywhere.

why.hi: Object creation ek jagah centralize karo. Caller ko sirf interface dikhe, concrete class nahi.
why.en: Centralize object creation in one place. Callers see only the interface, not the concrete class.

prompt.hi: Chaayos menu: base chai + adrak, elaichi, extra doodh, kulhad, kisi bhi combination me. Har combo ki alag class nahi banani.
prompt.en: Chaayos menu: base chai plus ginger, cardamom, extra milk, kulhad, in any combination. No separate class per combo.

why.hi: Har add-on base object ko wrap karke price aur description badhata hai. Class explosion se bachte ho.
why.en: Each add-on wraps the base object and adds to price and description. Avoids a class explosion.

prompt.hi: Zerodha Kite me ek "Buy" click ke peeche margin check, risk check, order validation aur exchange gateway call hote hain. UI ko ek simple method chahiye.
prompt.en: Behind one "Buy" click in Zerodha Kite are margin checks, risk checks, order validation and an exchange gateway call. The UI needs one simple method.

why.hi: Facade complex subsystems ko ek simple API ke peeche chhupata hai. Client ka coupling kam hota hai.
why.en: A facade hides complex subsystems behind one simple API. It reduces client coupling.
